text: 13 “I don’t like to tease, Brian, but how much longer?” Nick’s voice was taut. “There’s a river about four miles east of here — I saw it when we were coming down — and I reckon whatever’s coming is just now on the other side of it.” Brian glanced at his fuel readouts. 24,000 pounds in the right wing; 16,000 pounds in the left. It was going faster now that he didn’t have to pump the Delta’s fuel overwing to the other side. “Fifteen minutes,” he said. He could feel sweat standing out on his brow in big drops. “We’ve got to have more fuel, Nick, or we’ll come down dead in the Mojave Desert. Another ten minutes to unhook, button up, and taxi out.” “You can’t cut that? You’re sure you can’t cut that?” Brian shook his head and turned back to his gauges.
